Not much tandoori cooking despite the name
Jan 2026 • Family
First , let me say that the restaurant was well frequented by people of indian ethnicity on the night, I was there, and they knew their food and were mostly eating vegetarian.Which was actually excellent. The rest of what came left me rather non plussed because only half of what I ordered actually came . The waiter had 3 goes at getting my order right and then clearly still didn't. There was hardly anything that was cooked in the tandoor on the menu. One of the smoke alarms above us all annoyingly kept beeping all night , which must have been like that for a fair while or it would have been fixed.A bit of focus would help!

Exceptional food and service
Feb 2024 • Couples
We stumbled on this place as we were hungry for a bit of spice and so glad we did. The food was amazing! So much so that we went back 5 times ! Decor is welcoming and the service from the waiters and waitresses spot on. Now to the food. The Currys were all exceptional, perfectly spiced and hot. We tried various dishes and not one failed to impress. Absolutely make this the only Curry house you go to when visiting Hanoi, we did.

Authentic Indian cuisine in Hanoi's Old Quarter
Jan 2024 • Couples
Fantastic meal at this super-clean Indian restaurant in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter.
My wife and I craved for an authentic vegetarian Indian meal and Tandoor delivered. Everything we tasted brought back so many happy memories. 
The meal was so good, the addition of the controversial 20% public holiday surcharge charged by many eateries in Hanoi did not detract from our overall experience.
This hidden gem should not be missed - you will not be disappointed.
